title: INTERventional POLypharmacy - Drug interActions - Risks study 1
summary: The INTERPOLAR-1 study is a multicenter project that aims to improve digital support in routine clinical care at German university hospitals. IT support is being strengthened by ward pharmacists in order to increase the safety of drug therapy. Ward pharmacists perform medication analyses to identify and resolve medication-related problems (MRPs). To date, the documentation of these analyses has been insufficiently standardized and digitally supported, which makes it difficult to collect drug therapy safety data. The study implements standardized digital documentation for medication analyses and evaluates whether IT support can help identify more MRPs and document them more effectively. The aim is to collect and analyze comprehensive data on MRPs at university hospitals in Germany.

interventions.name: Adult inpatients in German university hospitals who are (co-)cared for by ward pharmacists

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients 18 years and older who are being cared for on wards with pharmaceutical services.
Exclusion criteria:
- pediatric wards
- intensive care units
- maternity wards
